Teaching notes

Call stack

JavaScript runs synchronous statements here, one at a time.

Microtasks

Promise then, catch, and finally callbacks. They run first after the stack is empty.

Macrotasks

Timer callbacks, browser events, and message tasks. JavaScript takes these only after microtasks are empty.
